stem.text: Nitrogen gas is unreactive, whereas oxygen gas and chlorine gas are reactive.
Which statements help to explain this difference?

items: The two $\text{N}$ atoms in an $\text{N}_2$ molecule are held together by a very strong triple bond.
The triple bond between two $\text{N}$ atoms is not polar. The bonds in $\text{O}_2$ and $\text{Cl}_2$ are polar.
The atoms in $\text{N}_2$ have a full outer shell of electrons. The atoms in $\text{O}_2$ and $\text{Cl}_2$ do not have a full outer shell of electrons.
